newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Goodman sees A$15 mln loss from Meneba sale.
newsitem.headline: Goodman sees A$15 mln loss from Meneba sale.

text.p: Food group Goodman Fielder Ltd said on Tuesday it had completed the sale of its Dutch-based milling and baking group Meneba N.V. for about A$310 million (465 million guilder) and would book an extraordinary loss of about A$15 million from the sale in its year-end accounts.
"We anticipate that there will be an extraordinary loss on the transaction of approximately A$15 million which will be included in the year-end accounts," Goodman Fielder said.
Goodman announced it would sell Meneba for slightly more than A$300 million to CVC Capital Partners in early March and said then it expected to record a small loss after transaction costs.
Goodman Fielder's share price closed unchanged at A$1.66 on Tuesday.
